adversarial_checks.finding: Changed local deltas are not part of the duplicate-request payload digest.
adversarial_checks.evidence: After a first F01 A evaluation, replacing the first delta action_label with TAMPERED and consume_by_role route_resource=2 returned the identical SELECTED KEEP_ROUTE decision (same object equality), rather than rejecting stale/reused content.
adversarial_checks.contract: The B3 runtime contract requires request_id/content digests and changed or stale requests to reject. Local delta receipt changes are decision inputs and must be bound to the idempotency digest.
adversarial_checks.required_follow_up: Digest every local delta and all decision-relevant receipt/ledger fields before idempotent replay; reject changed content under the same request identity.

adversarial_checks.finding: Optional STOP bypasses complete-option semantic coverage.
adversarial_checks.evidence: Replacing the F05 optional singleton option with a valid selection-0 EVOLVE option (type 9, deliberately outside the evaluator singleton allowlist) returned SELECTED with STOP and no delegation. The activation contract explicitly forbids ignoring unsupported EVOLVE options.
adversarial_checks.contract: Every available option must be covered before activation; optional STOP is legal only after the complete current option set is validated.
adversarial_checks.required_follow_up: Validate every available option's supported type, local delta, and semantic coverage before taking the min_count=0 STOP branch.

adversarial_checks.finding: Local deltas may consume more known resource than exists when that role is not in reserve_requirements.
adversarial_checks.evidence: Replacing F01 SPEND_REPLACEABLE with consume_by_role replaceable_search=99 still returned SELECTED KEEP_ROUTE; no capacity or recovery check rejected the impossible local delta.
adversarial_checks.contract: A current local delta must preserve known route feasibility and cannot spend unavailable public resources. Public discard/recovery is separate from usable copies.
adversarial_checks.required_follow_up: For every consumed role, enforce usable plus explicitly qualified recoverable capacity, or delegate with a distinct impossible-local-delta reason.

adversarial_checks.finding: Route proof uncertainty flags are ignored for ROUTE objectives.
adversarial_checks.evidence: For each of draw_obligation_known, recovery_known, and alternate_prize_route_known set false individually on an ordinary ROUTE F01 case, the evaluator still returned SELECTED KEEP_ROUTE.
adversarial_checks.contract: Unknown route requirements, recovery, or alternate Prize routes must not become favorable/usable facts; unknown must delegate B0.
adversarial_checks.required_follow_up: Gate both formulations on all required route-proof fields, not only DECKOUT.

adversarial_checks.finding: DECKOUT objective can select from a low deck count without a deck-out proof receipt.
adversarial_checks.evidence: F01 changed to objective_kind=DECKOUT, opponent_deck_count=1, and all three proof booleans true; it returned SELECTED KEEP_ROUTE. There is no deck-out predicate/receipt or draw-obligation calculation in the evaluator.
adversarial_checks.contract: B3-F04 guards that low opponent deck count does not prove deck-out. The current implementation only checks missing booleans and then scores the ordinary route.
adversarial_checks.required_follow_up: Require a version-bound exact deck-out proof/local receipt, otherwise always delegate DECKOUT decisions; do not treat the count or booleans as proof.

adversarial_checks.finding: Physical-copy source digests and reveal transitions are not integrity checked.
adversarial_checks.evidence: Two distinct physical receipts with the same source_digest were accepted. A reveal event with before_category=PUBLIC_INACCESSIBLE and after_category=PUBLIC_INACCESSIBLE was also accepted.
adversarial_checks.contract: Each public physical copy needs a unique source observation/event digest, and reveals must be monotonic and counted once without double counting.
adversarial_checks.required_follow_up: Require unique source digests, validate before against the recorded prior category, reject no-op/backward transitions, and bind event/source digests to the affected receipt.

adversarial_checks.finding: fixture_metadata_sha256 is only an asserted label, not a digest of fixture metadata.
adversarial_checks.evidence: Changing a common public entity card_id from 3 to 999 and changing its metadata_ref accordingly while retaining the all-f metadata digest was accepted by materialize_b3_fixture_data.
adversarial_checks.contract: Fixture authority and provenance must be version-bound; metadata tampering must fail closed rather than pass because a caller supplied the same 64-character label.
adversarial_checks.required_follow_up: Recompute the canonical metadata digest over the sealed receipt/public records/config dependency set and compare it, with explicit source/config/schema hashes.

adversarial_checks.finding: Allocation states are not validated against public capacities or a version-bound allocation measure.
adversarial_checks.evidence: Replacing both F01 candidate probability allocations with two identical three-card populations (route_out=2, blank=1) was accepted and B3-B selected SPEND_REPLACEABLE, despite the public state reporting a ten-card own deck and no allocation receipt.
adversarial_checks.contract: B3-B may use exact public count-state probability only when count states, conditioning fields, and allocation measure are version-bound and legal hidden allocations cannot change the ordering.
adversarial_checks.required_follow_up: Bind every population/allocation state to public hidden-slot capacities and a sealed allocation receipt; reject malformed totals, missing worlds, and unmeasured allocations.

adversarial_checks.finding: Known discard/recoverable copies are ignored when computing reserves.
adversarial_checks.evidence: The reserve computation subtracts only known_usable_by_role; known_discard_by_role is never consulted despite the contract allowing explicitly qualified recovery from PUBLIC_DISCARD_OR_RECOVERABLE.
adversarial_checks.contract: The B3 ledger row contract requires usable plus explicitly qualified recoverable copies in hard reserves, while unknown/discard states must not be silently treated as usable.
adversarial_checks.required_follow_up: Represent recoverability in the receipt and include only qualified recoverable counts in reserve feasibility; otherwise fail closed.

adversarial_checks.finding: Evaluator accepts a ledger that is inconsistent with the current public state capacities and has no dependency/provenance binding.
adversarial_checks.evidence: F01 state ResourceLedgerSeedV1 derives hidden own deck slots of 10, while its supplied ResourceLedgerV1 declares hidden_own_deck_slots=8; evaluation still selects. B3CapabilityReceiptV1 binds only a self-consistent synthetic role-count hash and receipt strings, not the fixture/config/public schema or knowledge-base dependencies.
adversarial_checks.contract: Public capacities are constraints, and fixture-only evidence must be provenance-pure and dependency/version bound.
adversarial_checks.required_follow_up: Cross-validate ledger capacities/visible copies with PublicStateV1 and add explicit immutable dependency hashes to the receipt/config.
